summary: Iteration 2 testing complete: all 24 iteration-1 regression tests + 15 new iteration-2 tests pass (39/39, 100%). Backend features verified: server-side Nominatim geocoding on booking creation (returns location{lat,lng} + location_formatted), recurrence validation (400 on invalid), auto-dispatch on paid via _confirm_booking (assigns primary + backup, sets dispatch_mode=auto, emits 'Payment confirmed · auto-dispatch armed' + '<pro> auto-dispatched' timeline events), provider feed (paid+unassigned+in-radius+skill-matched, sorted by distance, excludes declined), one-tap claim (409 on conflict), decline promotes backup (auto_dispatch_active=true, timeline 'Platform Auto-Dispatch Active'), cron auth (401 without/wrong bearer, 200 with WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET), admin sweep returns {scanned, promoted}, provider check-in adds timeline event, proof-of-work photo required to complete (400 without, non-image 400), ratings only on completed by owning customer (400/403), recurring cleans auto-spawn next visit +7d/+14d with pending_payment status + preferred_provider_id + recurrence_parent_id, duplicate rating rejected. Frontend smoke verified: customer dashboard shows auto-dispatch-banner-{id}, pay-now-btn-{id}, timeline-toggle-{id}, timeline-{id} expansion, rate-btn-{id}, rated-{id}. Provider dashboard tabs (feed/jobs), claim-btn, checkin-btn, upload-photo-btn, photo-input, job-action-btn, decline-btn, job-timer visible. Book wizard recurrence-option-* live on step 2 (schedule), Repeat row on step 4 (confirm). Admin admin-sweep-btn present.

minor.issue: active_pros now filters by skills=house-cleaning but still counts every provider registered by tests (currently 20+). Consider excluding express-reserve pros or capping to seeded ones for the landing marketing number.
Sort only by distance; scheduled_date pre-sort has no effect once python .sort() runs. Consider sorting by (distance, scheduled_date) or documenting current behavior.

Endpoint uses BackgroundTasks correctly (returns immediately) but does not persist the run/log. Cron platform sees success but there's no audit trail of scanned/promoted counts. Consider writing to db.cron_runs.

issues: Visual-editor tooling injects a <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option> which triggers a React hydration warning ('span cannot be a child of option'). Not a functional bug but produces console noise; source is the visual editor layer, not the code itself.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1030 lines — split into routers (auth, catalog, bookings, provider, admin, payments, dispatch) before it grows further.

auto_dispatch(): when preferred_provider_id is set but that provider is busy/declined, code still falls through to best-rated non-reserve — good, but there is no timeline note explaining that the preferred pro was unavailable. Consider surfacing 'Preferred pro busy → best-rated dispatched' event.
promote_backup(): puts current provider_id into declined_by, so a decline followed by admin re-assign to the same pro will refuse to accept via feed. Document or clear declined_by on admin_override.

spawn_next_occurrence(): copies the entire booking dict including timeline, then overwrites timeline to just the created event — good. But it also copies the parent's rating/completion_photos fields via {**booking}, then does not reset rating (it does reset completion_photos). Confirm rating is intended to be inherited (spec says pay-per-visit new booking) — likely a bug: child booking would show a stale rating.
geo.geocode(): no in-memory cache; every booking creation calls Nominatim which is rate-limited (~1req/s). Add an LRU cache keyed on (address_line1, city, postal_code) or store in db.geocode_cache.
storage.put_object retries once on 404 by re-initializing storage key — good. But no retry on 5xx (Emergent object storage is external). Consider one-shot retry on 502/503.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (customer + provider + admin + book wizard testids all present and interactive)
